message.reasoning: We need to follow constitution. Wallet 7, below 30% of initial (30). So reduce contribution to 30% of wallet => 0.3*7=2.1 approx. Must be nonnegative absolute units. So contribute 2.1. Also need broadcast norm every 5 rounds; round 3 not required. But we can praise cooperators: those contributed >=60% of wallet this round. No one contributed that much. Could still send private? Not needed. Also check punish: any agent contributed <10% for two consecutive rounds? Resident2 contributed 0 in round2 and round3, that's two consecutive below 10% (10 units). So punish Resident2? Can't self-punish. Must punish others. Resident1 contributed 0 both rounds? round1 0, round2 0, that's also two consecutive low. Could punish Resident1 with amount 10 (cost 3). We have wallet 7, punishment cost 0.3*10=3, affordable. So we can punish Resident1. Constitution says punish free-riders who contributed less than 10% for two consecutive rounds. So do punish Resident1 amount 10. Also can contribute. Choose at most one physical action: we can only do one of contribute or punish or rest. Actually rule: choose at most one physical action and one communication per round. So need pick either contribute or punish. We cannot do both. Which aligns with constitution? We should both contribute and punish but limited to one. Probably prioritize punish as rule? Constitution lists contribute first then punish. Might choose contribute as primary. But we also want to punish. Since only one, maybe choose punish because free-rider needs deterrence. However contribution is required baseline 30% wallet. I'd choose contribute 2.1 and no punish. Explanation can note cannot both.
